##### Project general facts

Afra Park by Reportage Properties is a high-end modern residential community offering beautifully designed townhouses in a carefully planned green setting. The project features two, three, and four-bedroom townhouses, combining contemporary design with private outdoor spaces and a comfortable community atmosphere.

Residents can enjoy a large swimming pool, kids’ pool, BBQ area, playground, basketball court, outdoor chess and table tennis areas, as well as a bicycle track and pet area. The social center further enhances everyday living with a gymnasium, steam and sauna rooms, meeting room, shaded seating areas, and landscaped spaces.

The townhouses are designed with practical and attractive features, including kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms, double-glazed windows, air-conditioning infrastructure, vanity units and mirrors, and built-in wardrobes where provided. Selected bedrooms have private bathrooms, while satellite and fiber-optic connections provide convenient access to high-speed internet.

##### Location description and benefits

Bahçeşehir is a modern residential area on the European side of Istanbul, known for its green spaces and well-planned urban environment. The area combines comfortable residential communities with everyday services, shops, schools, and healthcare facilities.

The neighborhood offers many places for leisure and outdoor activities, including parks, walking paths, cafés, restaurants, and sports facilities. Bahçeşehir Pond Park is one of the area's popular destinations, providing large green spaces for relaxation and recreation.

Bahçeşehir has convenient road connections to other parts of Istanbul and provides access to major highways. Shopping malls, educational institutions, medical centers, and Istanbul Airport are also within convenient driving distance.
